outlook.title: Well Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low pressure located several hundred miles south-southwest of the coast of southwestern Mexico are becoming better organized. The environmental conditions are conducive for development, and a tropical depression or tropical storm is expected to form later today

outlook.title: Central Pacific
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure could form well south or southwest of the Hawaiian Islands in a few days. Some gradual development is possible thereafter while it moves slowly and erratically.
